firstrun.title: First run
firstrun.intro: This app does not include any game files. Point it to your own legal copy of Fallout 2 (MASTER.DAT, CRITTER.DAT, optionally PATCH000.DAT and the DATA folder).
firstrun.privacy: Game files never leave your browser: nothing is uploaded to any server.
firstrun.drop: Or drop a folder, files or a ZIP archive here
firstrun.persist: Remember in this browser (offline mode, no need to pick again)
firstrun.persistHint: The copy takes about 0.5 GB on this device. You can remove it at any time.
firstrun.zipResumeHint: You can resume the ZIP import: pick the same archive again and finished files will be skipped.
firstrun.invalid: Game files are incomplete or damaged: {files}.
firstrun.quota: Not enough browser storage (about {need} MB needed). Untick remembering or free some space.
firstrun.noGameInZip: MASTER.DAT was not found in the archive.
firstrun.cleared: Saved game files were removed from this browser.
firstrun.verify.unknown: File structure is valid, but this is an unknown game edition (not guaranteed to work).
firstrun.verify.invalid: Checksum verification failed: files are damaged.
backup.title: Save backup
backup.mode.label: Import mode
backup.partial: Some saves were loaded, others were skipped as damaged or newer.
backup.nothingNew: The backup has no newer saves.
backup.corrupt: This is not a valid saves backup file.
backup.hint: Saves live only in this browser. Export them before clearing site data or changing device.
persist.denied: The browser does not guarantee data persistence: it may delete it when space is low or after a long break. Export your saves.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Fallout 2 Web
onboarding.step.folder: You will pick the game files on this screen. They stay in your browser only.
onboarding.step.profile: Controls: touch screen or mouse and keyboard. Change it with the button in the header.
onboarding.step.tutorial: In game we show a few short hints: movement, interaction, action menu, inventory, saving. You can skip them.
tutorial.hint.move: Tap or click a spot on the map to walk there.
tutorial.hint.interact: Tap an item or a person to use or pick it up.
tutorial.hint.actionMenu: Press and hold an object to open the action menu.
tutorial.hint.inventory: Open the inventory with the I key or the Inventory button.
tutorial.hint.save: Quick save is F5. Full saves are in the menu.
backup.auto.title: Automatic backup to a folder
backup.auto.hint: Pick a folder and your saves will be copied to .f2save files from time to time (the last 7 are kept).
backup.auto.denied: No permission to write to the folder. Choose the folder again.
backup.auto.failed: Could not write the backup to the folder.
